# About the Author

Kimberlee Centera, president and CEO of TerraPro Solutions, is a trailblazer in renewable energy project development, with over 35 years of expertise in de-risking complex utility-scale projects. She has guided Fortune 500 companies, developers, and investors through high-stakes mergers and acquisitions transactions, ensuring projects remain bankable, insurable, and compliant. A leading authority, she is a frequent contributor to North American Clean Energy and POWER Magazine, and a sought-after speaker and presenter at energy industry conferences. She has appeared on an extensive array of podcasts and nationally syndicated programs, including National Public Radio.
